purpose: Test whether setting the strongest negative displacement by one maximum calibration crossing overreacts to rare, extreme states.

basis.evidence: Current aggressive amplitude is max_i(w.x_i-threshold)/(w.direction) over all over-labeled calibration states. It guarantees crossing of the fitted linear separator for every selected training state, not correctness or optimal compression.
Strong activation perturbations can degrade quality in that paper's other behaviors. This motivates checking intensity but provides no mathematical-reasoning benefit guarantee.

basis.derivation: An empirical upper0.95 quantile limits the influence of the most extreme5percent of selected states. It trades the original all-calibration-state crossing target for a95percent empirical crossing target. This is our adaptation choice, not a paper reproduction or conformal safety guarantee.

exact_change.score: s_i=(w.x_i-threshold)/(w.direction), using original mixed labels, original layer21 states, original FP64 means/diagonal variances and separator.
exact_change.unchanged: All other controller constants, originalraw vector bytes/norm, selected outputlayer20, arithmetic max-probability confidence, paragraph boundaries and sampling.
exact_change.no_search: One fixed0.95 quantile; no alternate quantile, shrinkage factor or combined direction candidate after seeing results.

CPU_checks: Compute full-score distribution, per-question maximum, leave-one-question-out maximum sensitivity and the fixed0.95 quantile on original400/100 groups. Readout/labels already use500, so group agreement is only descriptive development stability. The ratio smaller/larger quantile must be>=0.90. Apply both coefficient curves to original saved greedy boundary statistics and require finite values and unchanged non-aggressive branches. The95percent crossing fraction is a definition check, not a predictive success metric.
risks: Large displacement may be necessary for difficult reasoning; reducing it can make output longer or less accurate.
The linear separator itself is only a behavior proxy, not a correctness boundary.
The original maximum might be stable across many questions rather than an isolated outlier; report that even if other gates pass.
Offline coefficient differences do not establish online compression.
if_CPU_passes: Create a separate versioned fit referencing the unchanged original vector. Prepare a fresh100-question original/candidate paired screen with fixed16000 cap, same code/model/assets and generation settings. Require5percent reduction of both thinking and total tokens, no correct-count loss and no cap increase. Stop on failure; reserve200 independent questions only for a passing frozen candidate. No expansion to7B or final test sets.
resources: CPU fitting uses local selected-layer backup. No new model forward, hidden replay, answers or environment installation. GPU remains off until user reopens for the prepared batch.
